caption: The Dr / Cr layout from the original Week 5 note: debit on the left, credit on the right, naira amounts below.

caption: Worked example 1: Capital Account credited and Cash Account debited with N5000. The source prints two different dates (Jan. 5 and Jan. 2); both are kept and flagged.
